Birding Walk With A Ranger

At Pine Island State Park

BOOK NOW

Come discover the birds at our newest state park! From bluebirds to eagles, you never know what will show up at Pine Island! Join a ranger on a roughly 1 mile leisurely birding walk around the park. Dress for the weather as the walk will happen rain or shine. Limited binoculars will be available to borrow as needed. Appropriate for ages 12 and up.
